sentences.japanese: その泥棒は渋々と自分の罪を認めた。
sentences.english: The thief reluctantly admitted his guilt.

sentences.japanese: うちの課長は私が何かを頼むといつも渋い顔をするんだ。
sentences.english: Our section chief always makes a face at me when I ask him for something.

sentences.japanese: 僕的にはもっと地味ってか渋い服が欲しいんですけどね。
sentences.english: For my tastes, I'd prefer plainer, or rather, more tasteful clothing.

sentences.japanese: まず目に飛び込んできたのは、大きなソファだ。渋い色の革張りで、座面も背もたれもゆったりしている。
sentences.english: The first thing that came to my attention was the large sofa. It was covered in sober-coloured leather, and the seat and the back both looked wide and comfortable.

sentences.japanese: 彼は招待を受け入れるのをたいそう渋っている。
sentences.english: He is very reluctant to accept the invitation.
